arxiv-2011-11655.title: On the relation between the
arxiv-2011-11655.creator: 𝐌𝐒
arxiv-2011-11655.description: Abstract P3H-20-73, TTP20-040 Abstract We compute the relation between the pole mass and the kinetic mass of a heavy quark to three loops. Using the known relation between the pole and the \overline{\rm MS} mass we obtain precise conversion relations between the \overline{\rm MS} and kinetic masses.

arxiv-2101-04893.title: Screen Recognition: Creating Accessibility Metadata for Mobile Applications from Pixels Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 8–13, 2021; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’21), May 8–13, 2021, Yokohama, Japan DOI: 10.1145/34117
arxiv-2101-04893.creator: Xiaoyi Zhang, Lilian de Greef, Amanda Swearngin, Samuel White, Kyle Murray, Lisa Yu, Qi Shan, Jeffrey Nichols, Jason Wu, Chris Fleizach, Aaron Everitt, Jeffrey P. Bigham
arxiv-2101-04893.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xiaoyi Zhang, Lilian de Greef, Amanda Swearngin, Samuel White, Kyle Murray, Lisa Yu, Qi Shan, Jeffrey Nichols, Jason Wu, Chris Fleizach, Aaron Everitt, Jeffrey P. Bigham. Many accessibility features available on mobile platforms require applications (apps) to provide complete and accurate metadata describing user interface (UI) components. Unfortunately, many apps do not provide sufficient metadata for accessibility features to work as expected.

arxiv-2104-00526.title: Fitting Elephants
arxiv-2104-00526.creator: Partha P Mitra
arxiv-2104-00526.description: Abstract Textbook wisdom advocates for smooth function fits and implies that interpolation of noisy data should lead to poor generalization. A related heuristic is that fitting parameters should be fewer than measurements ( Occam’s Razor ). Surprisingly, contemporary machine learning (ML) approaches, cf. deep nets (DNNs), generalize well despite interpolating noisy data.

arxiv-2105-06406.title: Thermodynamics of Hydration from the Perspective of the Molecular Quasi-Chemical Theory of Solutions
arxiv-2105-06406.creator: Dilipkumar N. Asthagiri, Michael E. Paulaitis, Lawrence R. Pratt
arxiv-2105-06406.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dilipkumar N. Asthagiri, Michael E. Paulaitis, Lawrence R. Pratt. The quasi-chemical organization of the potential distribution theorem — molecular quasi-chemical theory (QCT) — enables practical calculations and also provides a conceptual framework for molecular hydration phenomena.

arxiv-2112-13493.title: Structure of octonionic Hilbert spaces with applications in the Parseval equality and Cayley-Dickson algebras Thanks: This work was supported by the NNSF of China (11771412).
arxiv-2112-13493.creator: Qinghai Huo, Guangbin Ren
arxiv-2112-13493.description: Abstract . Contrary to the simple structure of the tensor product of the quaternionic Hilbert space, the octonionic situation becomes more involved. It turns out that an octonionic Hilbert space can be decomposed as an orthogonal direct sum of two subspaces, each of them isomorphic to a tensor product of an irreducible octonionic Hilbert space with a real Hilbert space.

arxiv-2204-05647.title: Combinatorial identities and hypergeometric series
arxiv-2204-05647.creator: Enno Diekema
arxiv-2204-05647.description: Abstract This paper describes a method to find a connection between combinatorial identities and hypergeometric series with a number of examples. Combinatorial identities can often be written as hypergeometric series with unit argument. In a number of cases these hypergeometric series are balanced and can be reduced to a simpler form.

arxiv-2404-08677.title: PMG : Personalized Multimodal Generation with Large Language Models Thanks: ∗ Both authors contributed equally to this work. Thanks: † The work was done when the authors were interns at Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab. Thanks: 🖂 Corresponding authors.
arxiv-2404-08677.creator: Xiaoteng Shen ∗†, Rui Zhang ∗ 🖂 {}^{*\text{\Letter}}, Xiaoyan Zhao †, Jieming Zhu, Xi Xiao 🖂 {}^{\text{\Letter}}
arxiv-2404-08677.description: Abstract . The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has revolutionized the capabilities of text comprehension and generation. Multi-modal generation attracts great attention from both the industry and academia, but there is little work on personalized generation, which has important applications such as recommender systems.

arxiv-2411-10766.title: Approximate Controllability of Fractional Differential Systems with Nonlocal Conditions of Order q ∈ ] 1 , 2 [ \displaystyle q\in]1,2[
arxiv-2411-10766.creator: A. Aberqi, Z.. Ech-chaffani, T. Karite, Fez Morocco. echzoubida@gmail.com
arxiv-2411-10766.description: Abstract In this manuscript, we are concerned with the approximate controllability of fractional nonlinear differential equations with nonlocal conditions of order 1 < q < 2 \displaystyle 1<q<2 in Banach spaces. As far as we know, few articles have investigated this issue. The idea is to see under which sufficient conditions the proposed control problem is approximately controllable.

arxiv-2503-05702.title: A Comprehensive Survey of Fuzzy Implication Functions
arxiv-2503-05702.creator: Raquel Fernandez-Peralta
arxiv-2503-05702.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Raquel Fernandez-Peralta. Fuzzy implication functions are a key area of study in fuzzy logic, extending the classical logical conditional to handle truth degrees in the interval [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . While existing literature often focuses on a limited number of families, in the last ten years many new families have been introduced, each defined by specific construction methods and having different key properties.

arxiv-2505-13255.title: Policy Contrastive Decoding for Robotic Foundation Models
arxiv-2505-13255.creator: Shihan Wu, Xu Luo, Ji Zhang, Junlin Xie, Jingkuan Song, Heng Tao Shen, Lianli Gao
arxiv-2505-13255.description: Abstract Robotic foundation models, or generalist robot policies, hold immense potential to enable flexible, general-purpose and dexterous robotic systems. Despite their advancements, our empirical experiments reveal that existing robot policies are prone to learning spurious correlations from pre-training trajectories, adversely affecting their generalization capabilities beyond the training data.

pmc-10551966.creator: Nanna Husted Jensen, Karoline Kragelund Nielsen, Inger Katrine Dahl-Petersen, Ulla Kampmann, Peter Damm, Per Ovesen, Elisabeth Reinhardt Mathiesen, Christina Anne Vinter, Emma Davidsen, Maja Thøgersen, Anne Timm, Lise Lotte Torvin Andersen, Sine Knorr, Dorte Møller Jensen, Helle Terkildsen Maindal
pmc-10551966.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionFace-it is a randomized controlled trial for women with recent gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and their families designed to evaluate the effect of a health promotion intervention on type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk and quality of life.

pmc-11642005.title: Auto-Rad: End-to-End Report Generation from Lumber Spine MRI Using Vision–Language Model
pmc-11642005.creator: Mohammed Yeasin, Kazi Ashraf Moinuddin, Felix Havugimana, Lijia Wang, Paul Park, Francisco Guillen-Grima
pmc-11642005.description: Background: Lumbar spinal stenosis (LSS) is a major cause of chronic lower back and leg pain, and is traditionally diagnosed through labor-intensive analysis of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans by radiologists. This study aims to streamline the diagnostic process by developing an automated radiology report generation (ARRG) system using a vision–language (VL) model.

pmc-12768676.title: PD55 Factors Associated With The Costs Of Inpatient Care For Preterm Born Infants In Brazil: A Nationwide Retrospective Study
pmc-12768676.creator: Aline Toledo, Julia Raffin, Emilie Batista Freire, Angela Ben, Johanna van Dongen, Esther Maas, Andre Santos, Rodrigo Luiz Carregaro, Judith Bosmans
pmc-12768676.description: IntroductionPrematurity accounts for 75 percent of neonatal morbidity, imposing a substantial burden on healthcare services that extends beyond the neonatal period and leads to considerable healthcare costs. This study aimed to investigate factors associated with inpatient healthcare costs for preterm born infants in the first year of life in Brazil.

pmc-13300855.title: Preoperative Anxiety Is Associated with Early Postoperative Pain After Arthroscopic Ankle Ligament Reconstruction: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-13300855.creator: Ryan Bou Raad, Mohamad Moussa, Gregoire Rougereau, Eugenie Valentin, Olivier Grimaud, Frederic Khiami, Nicolas Lefevre, Alexandre Hardy
pmc-13300855.description: Purpose: We evaluate the relationship between preoperative anxiety, as measured by the Surgical Fear Questionnaire (SFQ), and postoperative pain intensity during the first three days following arthroscopic ankle ligament reconstruction. A secondary objective was to determine whether preoperative anxiety levels are associated with failure to reach the Patient Acceptable Symptom State (PASS) threshold for pain by postoperative day 3.

pmc-13526369.creator: Binyue Xu, Xuhuan Li, Shangling Dong, Zheyuan Zhang, Dong Jin, Guoping Li, Jiesheng Wang
pmc-13526369.description: BackgroundAlzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder and the leading cause of dementia among the elderly, characterized by a gradual decline in memory and cognitive function.
